Since this is more than just meta-ibm, we should probably remove that from the commit message?  Maybe meta-openpower or treewide?
Done
If we no longer support talking to the OCC, should occ-control be entirely removed from P8 and P9 images?
OCC control is still used, I2C was P8 only, and SBEfifo was P9 only, so this removes the older items to clean code up.  Occ control still supports P10/P11 and any future work.

I mean:

- if it isn't used on P8, should we remove it from the image on all p8 systems?
- if it isn't used on P9, should we remove it from the image on all p9 systems?
Done
not done
Yes should be removed. Working on how to do that now.

There are "p10bmc" lines in this file. I don't think we should remove them. Just the "witherspoon" line.

OCC control base is now power 10 support so I removed the following.
#ifdef PLDM
#ifdef POWER10
#ifdef I2C_OCC
#ifdef READ_OCC_SENSORS
This appears to be a P10 based system. I don't think we should delete this file.

OCC control base is now power 10 support so I removed the following.
#ifdef PLDM
#ifdef POWER10
#ifdef I2C_OCC
#ifdef READ_OCC_SENSORS
I don't think you should delete the whole file. The "phosphor-gpio-monitor-presence" RDEPENDS is still valid.
Done
